items.item_text: resume
cover letter
Bachelor's degree in a related area and/or equivalent experience/training
Demonstrated experience with Tessitura Ticketing, Tessitura Analytics, and Google Analytics 4
Experience working within a large campus environment
Student Engagement & Campus Outreach [25%]
Under the Associate Director of Marketing, the Marketing Specialist helps plan and execute Cal Performances' on-the-ground campus campaigns. In this capacity, the Marketing Specialist:
Plans, executes, and evaluates in-person campus campaigns from start to finish
Coordinates physical postering, campus transport, and setup/change-outs for on-campus advertising placements

Serves as an ambassador for Cal Performances at campus outreach events—including but not limited to Caltopia, Cal Day, and Golden Bear Orientation—and is responsible for setting up our event table/booth, working the events, and tear-down. Serves as the direct liaison with Resident Advisors (RAs), faculty, Greek life organizations, and student groups to build and maintain campus relationships
Manages Student Union screen advertising
Plans, coordinates, and hosts student receptions, currently four (4) per season
Brochure Production Coordination [20%]
Project manages the season, fall, and midseason brochure production from start to finish
Corresponds with agents to establish points of contact, request marketing materials, and traffic proofs
Tracks collateral and asset collection and maintains files for season marketing collateral
Traffics brochure proofs to staff, collects edits, and traffics them back to the design team
Keeps copy decks up to date with all edits throughout the brochure editing process
Files ERFs for design, print, and postage; documents changes and addenda in ad schedules
Manage Marketing Plans and Schedules [15%]
Updates and maintains marketing plans and advertising schedules for all events on the  season
Tracks collateral needs and deadlines across the season
Track Sales and Expenses [10%]
Updates the weekly Actuals to Budget sales report in Google Sheets
Updates the student ticket sales reports
Tracks marketing campaign expenses
Prepares expenditure request forms (ERFs) for advertising purchases and other marketing expenses
Submits and tracks promo codes
Manage Marketing Ads and Materials [15%]
Proofreads ads and other marketing materials
Designs assets when needed, including both static  and video
Opens creative job orders
Drafts ad copy for print, radio, and e-newsletters
Creates UTMs for tracking our digital campaigns
Uploads or sends digital ads to various advertising partners
Manages promotion codes with the Box Office; creates an analytics report at the end of each season to gauge the success of these campaigns
Grassroots Marketing & Administrative Support [15%]
Maintains the grassroots email list of campus and community organizations
Coordinates and tracks email exchanges with relevant organizations
Performs other administrative duties as needed for various marketing projects
Must reside in the Bay Area
An interest in the performing arts and/or marketing or a related field
The successful candidate will have a love for and understanding of the performing and visual arts, in all genres and forms
Familiarity with the UC Berkeley campus community, student organizations, and student media outlets
Resourceful and eager to learn new systems, processes, and technologies
Accuracy and careful attention to detail
Comfortable with in-person outreach, speaking to groups, and relationship-building with student organizations, campus departments, and community groups
Ability to work on site at UC Berkeley during standard business hours, with occasional evening and weekend hours for campus events
Ability to transport and set up promotional materials across campus
Proficient in Google Sheets and Docs; Excel and Word; Adobe Photoshop, Acrobat, and Premiere
Demonstrated knowledge of marketing principles, concepts, strategies, and best practices
High capacity for working in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment with an ability to quickly and efficiently adapt to new information and/or changing priorities
Excellent writing and editing skills, including copywriting for print, digital, and radio
Must be organized and efficient with excellent time management skills

pay.source_text: ience. The budgeted hourly range that the University reasonably expects to pay for this position is $30.17 to $41.04
